answer: A tight ring of 33 clones hence holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the kernel calculation reruns each epoch, the zenith weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the nadir settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 70% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
